facts.value: For each passed exam, you will receive a digital language certificate indicating your language level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), which is recognized by the International Office and Global Office of Goethe University. This will be issued in bilingual format (German and English). This language certificate can be included in your application for studying abroad or later during your job search.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: All students can learn their grades only after receiving their certificate via email, approximately 4 to 5 weeks after the exam date.
